title: Sign vectors and coordinate subsets
statement: For each nonnegative integer $k$, sign vectors of length $k$ are in bijection with subsets of the $k$ coordinates: a sign vector corresponds to the set of coordinates where its value is $1$, and a subset corresponds to the sign vector that is $1$ on that subset and $-1$ elsewhere.
